org: nicolasdiaz
service: incident-management-system

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: python3.13
  region: us-east-1
  iam:
    role: arn:aws:iam::895179168118:role/LabRole
  environment:
    # Tablas DynamoDB
    USERS_TABLE: ${sls:stage}_t_usuarios
    INCIDENTS_TABLE: ${sls:stage}_t_incidentes
    CONNECTIONS_TABLE: ${sls:stage}_t_conexiones
    
    # S3 Bucket para imágenes
    IMAGES_BUCKET: ${sls:stage}-incident-images-bucket
    
    # WebSocket
    WEBSOCKET_ENDPOINT: !Sub 'https://${WebsocketsApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${sls:stage}'
    
    # JWT Secret (en producción usar SSM Parameter Store)
    JWT_SECRET: ${ssm:/incident-system/dev/jwt-secret, 'default-jwt-secret'}
    
    # Stage
    STAGE: ${sls:stage}

  httpApi:
    cors:
      allowedOrigins:
        - "*"
      allowedHeaders:
        - Content-Type
        - Authorization
      allowedMethods:
        - OPTIONS
        - GET
        - POST
        - PUT
        - DELETE

functions:
  # ==========================================
  # AUTENTICACIÓN
  # ==========================================
  register:
    handler: src/auth/register.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /auth/register
          method: post
    description: Registrar nuevo usuario (alumno, worker, admin)

  login:
    handler: src/auth/login.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /auth/login
          method: post
    description: Iniciar sesión y obtener JWT token

  # Authorizer personalizado para validar JWT
  authorizer:
    handler: src/auth/authorizer.handler
    description: Validar JWT tokens en requests autenticados

  # ==========================================
  # GESTIÓN DE INCIDENTES
  # ==========================================
  createIncident:
    handler: src/incidents/create.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /incidents
          method: post
    timeout: 30
    description: Crear nuevo incidente (requiere autenticación)

  listIncidents:
    handler: src/incidents/list.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /incidents
          method: get
    description: Listar incidentes con filtros (status, priority, category, etc.)

  getIncident:
    handler: src/incidents/get.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /incidents/{id}
          method: get
    description: Obtener detalle completo de un incidente

  updateIncident:
    handler: src/incidents/update.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /incidents/{id}
          method: put
    description: Actualizar estado y comentarios de incidente

  assignIncident:
    handler: src/incidents/assign.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /incidents/{id}/assign
          method: post
    description: Asignar trabajador a incidente (solo admin)

  # ==========================================
  # PERSONAL DE MANTENIMIENTO (WORKERS)
  # ==========================================
  listWorkers:
    handler: src/workers/list.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /workers
          method: get
    description: Listar personal de mantenimiento con carga de trabajo

  getWorkerStats:
    handler: src/workers/stats.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /workers/{workerId}/stats
          method: get
    description: Obtener estadísticas detalladas de un trabajador

  updateWorkerStatus:
    handler: src/workers/update_status.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /workers/{workerId}/status
          method: put
    description: Actualizar estado y ubicación del trabajador

  # ==========================================
  # ANALYTICS Y MÉTRICAS
  # ==========================================
  getMetrics:
    handler: src/analytics/metrics.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /analytics/metrics
          method: get
    description: Obtener métricas del sistema (incidentes por categoría, tiempos, etc.)

  getDashboard:
    handler: src/analytics/dashboard.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /analytics/dashboard
          method: get
    description: Dashboard con estadísticas en tiempo real

  # ==========================================
  # WEBSOCKET - NOTIFICACIONES EN TIEMPO REAL
  # ==========================================
  connectHandler:
    handler: src/websocket/connect.handler
    events:
      - websocket:
          route: $connect
    description: Manejar conexión WebSocket

  disconnectHandler:
    handler: src/websocket/disconnect.handler
    events:
      - websocket:
          route: $disconnect
    description: Manejar desconexión WebSocket

  defaultHandler:
    handler: src/websocket/default.handler
    events:
      - websocket:
          route: $default
    description: Ruta por defecto para WebSocket

  broadcastHandler:
    handler: src/websocket/broadcast.handler
    description: Enviar notificaciones broadcast a usuarios conectados

resources:
  Resources:
    # ==========================================
    # TABLA: USUARIOS
    # ==========================================
    TablaUsuarios:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:provider.environment.USERS_TABLE}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: userId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: email
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: role
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: userId
            KeyType: HASH
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: EmailIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: email
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
          - IndexName: RoleIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: role
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        # Estructura:
        # {
        #   userId: "usr_1a2b3c4d",
        #   email: "juan.perez@universidad.edu.pe",
        #   password: "$2b$12$hashed_password",
        #   name: "Juan Pérez",
        #   role: "alumno", // alumno | worker | admin
        #   phone: "+51999123456",
        #   studentCode: "2021100123",  // Solo para alumnos
        #   faculty: "Ingeniería",
        #   career: "Ingeniería de Sistemas",
        #   specialty: "Electricista",  // Solo para workers
        #   department: "Mantenimiento", // Solo para workers
        #   workloadPoints: 6,  // Solo para workers (0-20)
        #   maxWorkloadPoints: 20, // Solo para workers
        #   activeIncidents: 2, // Solo para workers
        #   totalResolved: 45, // Solo para workers
        #   avgResolutionTimeHours: 2.5, // Solo para workers
        #   rating: 4.5, // Solo para workers
        #   createdAt: 1700000000000,
        #   updatedAt: 1700000000000,
        #   status: "active" // active | inactive | busy
        # }

    # ==========================================
    # TABLA: INCIDENTES
    # ==========================================
    TablaIncidentes:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:provider.environment.INCIDENTS_TABLE}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: incidentId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: status
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: createdAt
            AttributeType: N
          - AttributeName: priority
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: assignedTo
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: incidentId
            KeyType: HASH
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: StatusCreatedAtIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: status
                KeyType: HASH
              - AttributeName: createdAt
                KeyType: RANGE
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
          - IndexName: PriorityIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: priority
                KeyType: HASH
              - AttributeName: createdAt
                KeyType: RANGE
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
          - IndexName: AssignedToIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: assignedTo
                KeyType: HASH
              - AttributeName: createdAt
                KeyType: RANGE
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        # Estructura:
        # {
        #   incidentId: "inc_xyz789abc",
        #   title: "Luz fundida en Aula 302",
        #   description: "La luz fluorescente está fundida",
        #   category: "electricidad", // mantenimiento-general | seguridad | infraestructura | limpieza | electricidad | plomeria | sistemas-tecnologia | elevadores | otros
        #   priority: "medium", // low | medium | high | urgent
        #   status: "pending", // pending | assigned | in_progress | resolved | closed
        #   location: {
        #     building: "Pabellón A",
        #     floor: 3,
        #     room: "302",
        #     specificLocation: "Aula de clases"
        #   },
        #   images: ["incidents/inc_xyz789abc/image1.jpg"],
        #   reportedBy: "usr_1a2b3c4d",
        #   assignedTo: "usr_worker123",
        #   createdAt: 1700000000000,
        #   updatedAt: 1700000000000,
        #   resolvedAt: null,
        #   comments: [
        #     {
        #       userId: "usr_worker123",
        #       userName: "Carlos López",
        #       comment: "Revisando el problema",
        #       timestamp: 1700005000000
        #     }
        #   ]
        # }

    # ==========================================
    # TABLA: CONEXIONES WEBSOCKET
    # ==========================================
    TablaConexiones:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:provider.environment.CONNECTIONS_TABLE}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: connectionId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: userId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: role
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: connectionId
            KeyType: HASH
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: UserIdIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: userId
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
          - IndexName: RoleIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: role
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
        TimeToLiveSpecification:
          Enabled: true
          AttributeName: ttl
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        # Estructura:
        # {
        #   connectionId: "abc123xyz789",
        #   userId: "usr_1a2b3c4d",
        #   role: "admin", // alumno | worker | admin
        #   connectedAt: 1700000000000,
        #   ttl: 1700086400 // 24 horas
        # }

    # ==========================================
    # S3 BUCKET - IMÁGENES DE INCIDENTES
    # ==========================================
    ImagesBucket:
      Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
      Properties:
        BucketName: ${self:provider.environment.IMAGES_BUCKET}
        PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
          BlockPublicAcls: true
          BlockPublicPolicy: true
          IgnorePublicAcls: true
          RestrictPublicBuckets: true
        CorsConfiguration:
          CorsRules:
            - AllowedOrigins:
                - "*"
              AllowedHeaders:
                - "*"
              AllowedMethods:
                - GET
                - PUT
                - POST
              MaxAge: 3000
        LifecycleConfiguration:
          Rules:
            - Id: DeleteOldIncidentImages
              Status: Enabled
              ExpirationInDays: 730  # 2 años
              Prefix: incidents/

    # ==========================================
    # S3 BUCKET POLICY
    # ==========================================
    ImagesBucketPolicy:
      Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
      Properties:
        Bucket: !Ref ImagesBucket
        PolicyDocument:
          Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: arn:aws:iam::730872172556:role/LabRole
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
                - s3:PutObject
                - s3:DeleteObject
              Resource: !Sub "${ImagesBucket.Arn}/*"

    # ==========================================
    # SNS TOPIC - NOTIFICACIONES
    # ==========================================
    IncidentNotificationsTopic:
      Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
      Properties:
        TopicName: ${sls:stage}-incident-notifications
        DisplayName: Notificaciones de Incidentes Universitarios
        # Subscripciones se pueden agregar manualmente:
        # - Email de administradores
        # - SMS para incidentes urgentes
        # - Lambda functions para procesamiento

custom:
  pythonRequirements:
    dockerizePip: true
    layer: true
    slim: true
    strip: false
    zip: true
    usePipenv: false
    usePoetry: false

outputs:
  WebsocketEndpoint:
    Value:
      Fn::Sub: "wss://${WebsocketsApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${sls:stage}"
    Description: WebSocket endpoint para notificaciones en tiempo real
  
  ApiEndpoint:
    Value:
      Fn::Sub: "https://${HttpApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
    Description: HTTP API endpoint para REST API
  
  ImagesBucket:
    Value: !Ref ImagesBucket
    Description: S3 Bucket para almacenar imágenes de incidentes
